description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a positive culture for both residents and staff. This role comes with a competitive salary, reflecting the importance of this leadership position.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated leadership, financial management, and operational oversight abilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: $115,000 - $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
